name: Kessar Prime
omen: A night-side ring of neon cities beneath orbital docks, where breathing air is sold by the hour.

regions.name: Arcology Vesh
regions.description: A 3-kilometer arcology tower owned by Halcyon Biosystems; the upper decks have gardens and clean air, the lower decks have rationed oxygen and noodle stalls.

regions.name: The Sump
regions.description: Flooded foundations under the arcologies where unregistered citizens, rogue clinics and scrap-AI markets thrive.

regions.name: The Ashfields
regions.description: Toxic plains of collapsed pre-Compact cities, crossed only in sealed suits by scavengers and cultists.

regions.name: Orbital Dock 9
regions.description: A zero-g shipyard where indentured riggers build colony ships they will never board.

history.title: The Burning
history.summary: Runaway industry poisoned the atmosphere; open-air cities collapsed.

history.title: The Compact
history.summary: Seven corporations sealed the survivors inside arcologies in exchange for citizenship contracts.

history.title: Air Exchange
history.summary: Breathable air became a traded commodity priced by deck level.

history.title: The Lantern Uprising
history.summary: A rogue AI named Lantern helped Sump dwellers hack oxygen quotas before being 'deleted'.

history.title: Exodus Project
history.summary: Halcyon began building colony ships at Dock 9, with seats sold only to shareholders.

hooks: Lantern may not be deleted: fragments of it are whispering to Sump children through old terminals.
Halcyon is quietly raising oxygen prices on the lower decks before the Exodus launch.
A black clinic offers free lung implants that seem to report on their owners.
The riggers' union at Dock 9 is planning a strike that could ground the colony ships.

relations.note: Kessar's deep-space scans have not yet resolved Asterra's lights.
